post.line: The sorting pile is still on the counter. Come sort it before it learns the alphabet.

condo.line: The arcade floor and machines are waiting. Come in when you can; neither has improved itself.

store.line: The store shelf needs restocking. Come in when you can; the empty spaces have become very confident.

cafe.line: The counter has been quiet without you this week. Come and pour a few cups when you can.

stand.line: The stand reports low staffing this week. Please report for a shift at your earliest convenience.

post.line: You stopped coming in, so you are off the book. Ask again and you start at the first pile. Noted.

condo.line: You stopped coming, so your name is off the arcade book. Ask again and you start from the first rung.

store.line: You stopped coming, so your name is off the store book. Ask again and you start as new.

cafe.line: Your cups went cold, so you are off the Coffee Cup book. Ask again and you start from the first cup.

stand.line: Attendance review complete: your position is vacated. You may reapply, starting again at entry level.

cafe.line: Come to the Coffee Cup when you can. I have news, and your last cup already knew it.

stand.line: Please report to the lemonade stand. Management has news regarding your position.

condo.line: Come and see me at the arcade! I have news, and the cabinets are sworn to secrecy.

store.line: Come by the store when the bell is quiet. I have news that will not keep on a shelf.

post.line: Come by the post office when you can. I have news, and it has been weighed.

wage.line: I have filed {n} coins for the work you finished. They waited in the folder, as folders do.
wage.none: Nothing was entered on the work list, so nothing was filed. I have kept the blank space tidy.

review.full: A full week: {xp} work XP extra.
review.poor: A poor week: {xp} work XP taken back.

wage.warned: Your boss wants a word about it.
wage.demoted: You were moved down a rank.

welcome.line: I have entered {home} in the big book. The plot is yours at last. I am glad to close that folder.

movedin.line: I swept past {home} and saw the tent up. It looks lived in now, which is the point of a tent.

firstbeast.line: I heard there is an animal at {home}. Good. A plot with an animal has started making sense.

shed.line: I hear your shed is filling up. Good. A thing on a shelf is a thing with plans.

week.line: The big book says {home} has been yours for one week. I thought you should know; it rarely volunteers.
